notes: v1.0.19 — (1) Minecraft settings NEVER reset: a config guard snapshots your options.txt / servers.dat / config files before any operation that could touch an instance (version changes, modpack overrides, FPS-cap writes) and restores them if anything goes wrong — verified by a new smoke test. (2) Minecraft SURVIVES launcher updates: the game now runs fully detached, and when you update the launcher your running Minecraft keeps playing; after the ~3s wait the updated launcher reopens itself and RECONNECTS to the still-running game (validated PIDs — no stale/recycled ones). Update loops are impossible and a failed update keeps the old launcher. (3) Import/Share: imports restore the EXACT shared versions with dependencies resolved and de-duplicated, are cancellable (partial profile removed cleanly), show real progress, and share packages are sanitized (nothing personal can leak). Share links reimagined://share/CODE open the launcher straight into Import.
